name: Security Review (contributes.agents example)
description: EXAMPLE — a complete manifest showing contributes.agents: the app ships a security-reviewer agent along with the model it runs on, a reusable config bundle, and the group whose instructions its members share. Validate with: python tests/validate_manifest.py examples/contributes-agents/aw-app.json

agent_configs.name: Security Review Config
agent_configs.description: Read-only repo access plus the workspace MCP gateway — a reviewer reads and reports, it never writes.

groups.name: Security Reviewers
groups.description: Agents that review changes for security defects.
groups.capabilities: Reviews a diff or a repo for injection, authz, secret-handling and dependency risks. Reports findings; never edits code.

agents.name: Security Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews a branch or PR for security defects and reports them ranked by severity.
use_cases: review this branch for security issues

apps.reason: Provides the contributes.agents surface (it holds the Agents Platform base URL + token). Non-required on purpose: the declaration is HELD and replayed the moment a provider appears, so this app installs and works without it — the agent just isn't seeded yet.
